top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level active-aerodynamics control transport-and-safety IP. Accepts request packets, supervises service interaction, validates sequence/freshness/timeout, applies clamps, and emits safe actuator commands and status responses. The top module integrates the packet decoder, FSM, freshness checker, clamp block, and safe fallback controller, while delegating any bulk queue storage to technology-neutral FPGA BRAM wrappers.
top_module.functionality: Implements the complete FPGA-side transport and supervisory contract for adaptive aero control. It decodes compact request packets containing opcode, transaction sequence number, stream velocity, geometry metadata, and control flags; accepts at most one active transaction plus optional shallow queueing; forwards service work to the external integration layer; checks echoed response sequence, freshness, and timeout; clamps actuator recommendations to safe limits; and drives bounded actuator commands plus status responses. It must never generate actuator outputs from stale, mismatched, invalid, or timed-out responses. Safe fallback mode is asserted on reset, service_error, invalid packet decode, stale response, or timeout and remains active until a valid, fresh, acknowledged command supersedes it.
responsibilities: Accept request stream traffic using ready/valid handshakes.
Capture and compactly decode opcode, sequence, stream velocity, geometry metadata, and control flags from req_data.
Maintain sequence/freshness state for one outstanding transaction, with optional depth-2 queueing when enabled by parameter.
Coordinate service request/response supervision using service_busy, service_done, and service_error inputs.
Emit response packets that include echoed sequence number, acceptance/rejection, freshness, timeout, clamp, and summary status fields.
Generate actuator commands only from validated, fresh responses and only after clamp enforcement.
Force conservative fallback on reset, invalid decode, timeout, stale response, or service error.
Support backpressure on request, response, and actuator streams.
Keep all compact metadata within the fixed port widths and avoid storing mesh or flow-field payloads.
Ensure no dropped accepted transaction without a corresponding status response.
top_module.reset_behavior: On rst_n deassertion, clear outstanding transaction state, queue occupancy, freshness tracker, timeout counter, clamp state, and service handshake tracking. Force req_ready low until internal state is initialized, deassert resp_valid and act_valid, drive act_data to safe fallback contents, and mark fallback_active and status error indications as asserted until a valid fresh command is accepted and acknowledged.
behavior_rules: The top shall be single-clock synchronous logic only.
The top shall not infer unbounded FIFOs or any register-bank-style payload storage for bulk traffic.
The top shall parameterize timeout cycles, sequence width, clamp limits, status encoding, and optional queue depth.
The top shall allow at most one active request transaction unless optional queue depth 2 is enabled through parameters and implemented with BRAM or compact state.
Each accepted request shall be assigned a sequence number and tracked until a matching fresh response is validated or timeout occurs.
A response is valid only when its echoed sequence matches the current outstanding sequence, it arrives before timeout, and the request is still current.
Any stale response shall be reported in resp_data and shall not affect act_data except by reinforcing fallback status.
Clamp enforcement shall bound actuator target position(s) or mode bits to parameterized minimum/maximum values before act_data is driven.
Fallback mode shall remain active until a valid fresh acknowledged command supersedes it.
All status flags for valid, stale, timeout, clamp, service_error, and fallback_active shall be represented in the response/actuator summaries.
The design shall be synthesizable and suitable for FPGA implementation without ASIC-only SRAM macros.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_packet_decode
modules.description: Compact request packet decoder that extracts opcode, transaction sequence number, stream velocity metadata, DrivAerML/STL geometry reference metadata, and control flags from req_data. Provides validity checks for the request envelope and flags malformed or out-of-envelope packets without storing full payloads.
modules.functionality: Performs packet decode and compact field extraction for the top-level transport contract. The decoder shall recognize request structure, check basic envelope validity, enforce that velocity metadata is representable within the supported 20 to 55 m/s envelope, and provide a compact summary field for downstream status generation. It shall not contain the AI model, any mesh storage, or any flow-field computation.
responsibilities: Decode inbound request packet fields from req_data_i.
Validate opcode, sequence, velocity metadata, geometry metadata, and control flags.
Emit compact packet summary and decode-valid indication to downstream control logic.
Assert packet error for malformed packets, unsupported encoding, or out-of-envelope metadata.
Keep only compact metadata; do not store or reconstruct full geometry or field data.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset all decode-valid, error, and extracted field registers to zero. Deassert req_ready_o only if internal initialization requires it; otherwise allow flow-through ready behavior after reset release. No persistent packet data shall remain latched across reset.
behavior_rules: All extracted fields shall be fixed-width compact metadata values within the declared port widths.
Velocity metadata shall be interpreted relative to the supported operating envelope and default reference point.
The decoder shall generate pkt_error_o for invalid packet formats or unsupported encodings.
The decoder shall not emit any downstream semantic control other than compact decoded fields and summary status.
The module shall be synthesizable and purely synchronous with clk and rst_n.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_fsm
modules.description: Control FSM that sequences IDLE, CAPTURE_REQUEST, ISSUE_SERVICE_REQUEST, WAIT_SERVICE, VALIDATE_RESPONSE, APPLY_CLAMP, OUTPUT_ACTUATOR, SAFE_FALLBACK, and ERROR_HOLD behavior. It arbitrates between request acceptance, service supervision, response validation, and fallback handling.
modules.functionality: Implements the supervisory state machine and transaction lifecycle. It accepts a decoded packet, issues a service request, waits for external completion, validates freshness, applies clamp decisions, drives response/actuator output enables, and enters safe fallback or error hold when required. It does not compute any aerodynamics model output and only sequences transport, validation, and safety behavior.
responsibilities: Sequence through IDLE, CAPTURE_REQUEST, ISSUE_SERVICE_REQUEST, WAIT_SERVICE, VALIDATE_RESPONSE, APPLY_CLAMP, OUTPUT_ACTUATOR, SAFE_FALLBACK, and ERROR_HOLD states.
Gate acceptance of requests based on packet validity and current transaction occupancy.
Track timeout, service error, stale response, and clamp events.
Qualify response and actuator output enables.
Assert fallback_active_o whenever reset, invalid packet, stale response, timeout, or service_error occurs.
Provide compact status summary and state code for downstream packaging.
modules.reset_behavior: Enter SAFE_FALLBACK on reset. Clear state_code_o to IDLE-equivalent, deassert packet acceptance and service request, clear resp_valid_o and act_valid_o, assert fallback_active_o, and hold error_hold_o low unless a persistent error condition is externally latched by the controlling logic.
behavior_rules: State machine transitions shall be synchronous and single-clock.
The FSM shall not drop an accepted request without eventually producing a status response.
The FSM shall treat stale or timed-out events as fallback triggers and shall prevent actuator output enable on such events.
State encoding shall be compact and parameterizable via top-level status encoding assumptions.
The FSM shall not infer any bulk storage; it consumes compact decoded fields and status flags only.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_freshness_checker
modules.description: Sequence and freshness checker that validates echoed response sequence numbers against the outstanding request and supervises timeout expiration. It ensures only the current request can authorize actuator release and marks stale or mismatched responses.
modules.functionality: Maintains the single outstanding sequence number, compares echoed response sequences, and drives freshness and timeout qualification. The checker enforces that a response must match the current sequence and arrive before timeout expiry to be considered fresh. It supports optional shallow queueing only through compact control state and BRAM-backed request buffering at the top level, but it does not itself implement unbounded buffering.
responsibilities: Capture the accepted request sequence number as the current outstanding sequence.
Compare response sequence against the current outstanding sequence.
Assert fresh_ok_o only for matching, in-time responses.
Assert fresh_stale_o for mismatched, late, or obsolete responses.
Assert timeout_o when age exceeds configured timeout limit.
Provide the current outstanding sequence and age counter for status visibility.
modules.reset_behavior: Clear the outstanding sequence, age counter, and all status outputs on reset. Deassert freshness and timeout indications until a valid request is accepted and tracked.
behavior_rules: Only one outstanding request is actively validated at a time unless the top-level queue parameter is enabled and front-end buffered.
Sequence comparison shall be exact width matching.
Timeout shall be measured in clk cycles with a parameterized limit.
Late or mismatched responses shall be flagged stale and must not qualify actuator release.
The module shall be synchronous and synthesizable.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_clamp_block
modules.description: Bounded actuator clamp logic that constrains target position(s) and mode bits to parameterized limits and produces a compact clamp-hit indication. It converts validated recommendation values to safe, legal actuator command values.
modules.functionality: Applies parameterized minimum and maximum bounds to actuator target values and formats the resulting safe actuator fields. The clamp block shall operate on compact recommendation data only and shall emit a clamp indicator whenever the requested value exceeds the legal actuator envelope or when fallback is active.
responsibilities: Clamp recommendation values to configured minimum and maximum limits.
Pass through or sanitize actuator mode bits within the declared width.
Assert clamp_hit_o when clamping occurs or when safe fallback forces conservative output.
Expose a safe indicator for packaging into response and actuator streams.
Ensure outputs remain bounded in all operating conditions.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, drive clamped_value_o to a conservative minimum-risk value, mode_bits_o to a safe mode encoding, clamp_hit_o high if fallback semantics require explicit indication, and safe_indicator_o asserted. No unbounded state shall persist.
behavior_rules: Clamp limits shall be parameterized and honored for all outputs.
Safe fallback shall override non-conservative recommendations.
The module shall not infer geometry or flow computation.
The module shall be synchronous and synthesizable.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_safe_fallback_controller
modules.description: Safe fallback controller that assembles conservative actuator command content and fallback status when reset, invalid packet decode, stale response, timeout, or service error occurs. It provides minimum-risk actuator positions or mode bits and a compact fallback summary.
modules.functionality: Generates the conservative actuator state used during fallback. The controller synthesizes a safe minimum-risk actuator position and safe mode bits whenever a triggering condition occurs and holds fallback active until a valid, fresh, acknowledged command supersedes it. It does not compute aerodynamic optimization and does not rely on any external model output.
responsibilities: Detect or accept fallback trigger conditions.
Drive conservative actuator value and mode encodings.
Assert fallback_active_o while safety fallback is in force.
Provide compact summary for response packaging and debug visibility.
Remain active until cleared by a valid fresh command sequence.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, enter fallback active state immediately, output conservative actuator value and safe mode bits, and emit a fallback summary reflecting reset-origin fallback. Clear only when a valid fresh acknowledged command is later accepted by top-level control.
behavior_rules: Fallback outputs shall be conservative and parameterizable through top-level clamp assumptions.
Any trigger input shall cause or maintain fallback active behavior.
No stale or timed-out output may bypass this controller in the safety path.
The module shall be synchronous and synthesizable.

top_level_connections.description: Distribute the single system clock to all synchronous submodules.
Fan out the active-low synchronous reset to all submodules.
Inbound request stream valid to packet decoder.
Inbound 128-bit request packet to packet decoder.
Response backpressure input to the supervisory FSM accept path.
Actuator stream backpressure input to the supervisory FSM accept path.
External service busy indication to the FSM.
External service completion indication to the FSM.
External service error indication fans into the FSM and fallback controller.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_valid
inter_module_signals.description: Decoded request validity qualifier from packet decoder to supervisory FSM.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_error
inter_module_signals.description: Packet decode error indication used by FSM and fallback controller.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_opcode
inter_module_signals.description: Decoded opcode forwarded to the FSM for transaction classification.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_seq
inter_module_signals.description: Decoded transaction sequence forwarded to FSM and freshness checker.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_velocity
inter_module_signals.description: Compact velocity metadata forwarded to the FSM for envelope and policy decisions.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_geom_meta
inter_module_signals.description: Compact geometry metadata identifying DrivAerML/STL reference geometry.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_ctrl_flags
inter_module_signals.description: Control flags extracted from the inbound request packet.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_summary
inter_module_signals.description: Compact packet summary used by the FSM for packaging and status control.

inter_module_signals.name: req_ready_int
inter_module_signals.description: Request ready handshake from packet decoder to top-level request interface.

inter_module_signals.name: pkt_accept
inter_module_signals.description: Transaction acceptance pulse from FSM to freshness checker.

inter_module_signals.name: service_req
inter_module_signals.description: Internal service request strobe emitted by the FSM; preserved as a named internal handshake contract for integration visibility.

inter_module_signals.name: fresh_ok
inter_module_signals.description: Freshness-qualified response indication from the freshness checker to the FSM.

inter_module_signals.name: fresh_stale
inter_module_signals.description: Stale-response indication forwarded to FSM and fallback controller.

inter_module_signals.name: timeout
inter_module_signals.description: Timeout indication forwarded to FSM and fallback controller.

inter_module_signals.name: clamped_value
inter_module_signals.description: Clamped actuator target value exported to the top-level actuator stream.

inter_module_signals.name: clamp_hit
inter_module_signals.description: Clamp-hit indication to supervisory FSM.

inter_module_signals.name: state_code
inter_module_signals.description: Compact FSM state code embedded in the response packet summary.

inter_module_signals.name: resp_valid_int
inter_module_signals.description: Outbound response valid from FSM to top-level response stream.

inter_module_signals.name: act_valid_int
inter_module_signals.description: Outbound actuator valid from FSM to top-level actuator stream.

inter_module_signals.name: fallback_active_top
inter_module_signals.description: Internal fallback-active visibility for top-level supervisory status contract.

inter_module_signals.name: safe_fallback_trigger_reset
inter_module_signals.description: Logical ownership relation for reset-origin fallback state; the actual reset is top-driven and the destination is included to document control dependency.
